assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR / height / official green-ratio metrics remain unknown until official controls arrive; the package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only against provided official/provisional geometry.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough rectangles derived from the announcement's text boundaries and announced area values; they must NOT be interpreted as road redlines or precise statutory boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Any precision-sensitive metric must be recalculated once the official CAD/GIS polygon is published.

assumptions.statement: All cultural-heritage interpretation references publicly published sources and does not reproduce copyrighted text, images, or brand identities.
assumptions.impact: Cultural narrative in proposal.md is a synthesis layer; original sources must be cited by URL and title.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards apply human-review, opt-in data, and aggregation-only analytics; no individual biometric or location data is assumed to be available.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards remain concept suggestions for future ops; runtime deployment requires independent privacy review.
